svg.title: Axiom Research - Research Workflow
svg.desc: Overall workflow, not an automated capability claim for every module. Research inputs enter an LLM-assisted workflow. The host selects reviewed Skills at each technical stage; validated numerical programs perform calculations. Missing evidence returns the workflow to evidence review. Researchers approve and perform physical experiments externally, import results for comparison with frozen predictions, and validate versioned model updates before recalibration. See the capability status table for module-specific support.
